vector_memory.semantic_summary: JarvisAiModel is a specialized service wrapper implementing a drop-in client interface for a custom proprietary FastAPI backend endpoint ('JARVIS'). Its primary role is abstracting HTTP communication, allowing standard LLM orchestration layers to interact with the custom service seamlessly. It manages connection parameters like base_url and server_model, handling both synchronous and streaming chat completions. It incorporates robust retry logic via RetryPolicy and surfaces network/server errors as LLMAPIError.
